tasks.label: Initialize milestone Git
tasks.command: git init; git config user.name; git config user.email; git status --short

tasks.label: Commit milestone 1
tasks.command: git add .gitignore .vscode/tasks.json app build.gradle.kts gradle.properties gradle gradlew gradlew.bat settings.gradle.kts; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git commit -m 'M1: identity and Compose skeleton' }

tasks.label: Commit milestone 2
tasks.command: git add app/build.gradle.kts gradle/libs.versions.toml app/src/main/java/com/example/localpost/MainActivity.kt app/src/main/java/com/example/localpost/GossipScreen.kt app/src/main/java/com/example/localpost/Post.kt app/src/main/java/com/example/localpost/PostStore.kt app/src/test/java/com/example/localpost/PostTest.kt .vscode/tasks.json; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git commit -m 'M2: signed persistent local posts' }
